thread:
Sam: kicking off A/B for rwd-v7p0-int4 at 10:02 PT -> 2% treatment, control v7p0-fp16. Goal: rerank NDCG + structured JSON fidelity. id ab-20260322-1745557777
DeployBot: experiment ab-20260322-1745557777 started (2% treatment). snapshot_ts=1745557777
Nina: initial 20m look: overall NDCG -0.4pp, but structured-output parse_fail rate jumped from 0.05% -> 0.9% in treatment. That’s huge for webhook ingestion.
Eli: parse_fail examples look like truncated JSON (tokenizer cut inside a unicode escape) and occasionally an extra trailing comma. Suspect token-boundary behaviour after quantized logits rounding.
Sam: wow. Do we have per-slice? long-instructions vs short-snack prompts?
Nina: slice: short-chat neutral, assistant-long NDCG -1.6pp and parse_fail 1.6% there. Rerank-heavy -0.8pp.
Marta: infra: exporting json_parse_errors metric now. Also adding a temporary hard gate: parse_fail_rate_treatment - parse_fail_rate_control > 0.2pp => auto-pause.
InfraBot: alert rule created: AB_PARSE_GATE (threshold 0.2pp).
Eli: can we reproduce locally with the exact tokenizer boundary cases? I’ll dump logits and byte offsets for failing examples to s3://redwood-ab/1745557777/fails/
Sam: pause the AB and roll back while we triage. Safety-first.
DeployBot: AB paused; traffic rebalanced to 100% control at 10:08 PT. experiment marked PAUSED.
Nina: quick root cause hypothesis: quantization-induced token-prob rounding moves highest-prob token at the end of sequence across a byte boundary, creating invalid escape sequences when decoded to JSON.
Eli: plan: 1) run targeted reproducer that replays failing examples with deterministic RNG and logs token boundaries + decoded strings (Eli). 2) add preflight sampling of 1000 strict JSON prompts during canary and block if parse_fail >0.1% (Sam). 3) explore soft-decoding patch: if decoder sees invalid escape, prefer next-token candidate and re-decode (ML + infra research).
Marta: infra to add json_parse_errors, tokenizer_boundary_shift metric, and an alert if tokenizer_boundary_shift > 5/min during any canary.
Sam: add to rollout docs: structured-output fidelity is a hard safety dimension that overrides cost wins. Cost delta cannot veto parse_fail hard gate.
Eli: uploading artifacts now -> s3://redwood-ab/1745557777/artifacts.tgz
Nina: will run a quick local kernel test to see if different softmax temperature mitigates boundary flips.
Sam: thanks. reopening when reproducer is green. :white_check_mark:
